Correct answer: B

A: X and Y have the same nucleon number ( and respectively), but since they have different proton numbers ( and ), they are different elements.

B: Isotopes are defined as atoms of the same element (same proton number) that have different numbers of neutrons. Both W and X have protons, identifying them both as sodium, but they have different neutron counts ( and ).

C: Y and Z have the same number of neutrons (), but different proton numbers ( and ). Particles with the same neutron number but different proton numbers are called isotones, not isotopes.

D: W and Z have different proton numbers ( and ), so they belong to different elements. Although they share the same number of neutrons (), they are not isotopes.
